key_features: Distinct spectacle hood mark, dark brown/black body, elliptical pupils, threat hood expansion
first_aid_protocol: Immobilize limb below heart level. Apply pressure immobilization bandage. Transport to regional AVS hospital immediately.

key_features: Triangular head, three rows of dark brown ovoid spots, loud warning hiss, keeled scales
first_aid_protocol: Do NOT apply tourniquet or incision. Immobilize patient. Monitor for renal failure & hemotoxic bleeding.

key_features: Glossy black body with narrow white cross-bands, hexagonal vertebral scales, nocturnal bites
first_aid_protocol: Pre-synaptic neurotoxin causes painless bites at night. Immediate artificial respiration & AVS administration required.

key_features: Serrated keeled scales, figure-8 threat display, zigzag body pattern, small size (<60cm)
first_aid_protocol: Elevate limb slightly. Monitor prothrombin time. Administer Polyvalent AVS serum.

key_features: Large length (3-5.5m), chevron band pattern, growling hiss, massive venom yield (400-500mg)
first_aid_protocol: High-volume venom yield. Immediate mechanical ventilation & polyvalent antivenom titration.

key_features: Bright green body, triangular head, heat-sensing loreal pits, prehensile tail
first_aid_protocol: Local tissue swelling and pain. Symptomatic treatment and monovalent/polyvalent AVS if systemic.

key_features: Large yellow-brown body, black net tail marking, vertical black lip stripes, round eyes
first_aid_protocol: Wash thoroughly with soap and water. Apply antiseptic dressing. Verify Tetanus Toxoid vaccination.

key_features: Chocolate brown with reticulated black crossbars, white speckled forebody, dual eye stripes
first_aid_protocol: Cleanse bite scratches with antiseptic. Sterile gauze dressing. Reassure non-venomous nature.
